title: Thursday 130404
wodRaw:
[CrossFit Games Open 13.5](http://games.crossfit.com/workouts/the-open/2013#tabs-5)  
  
Complete as many rounds and reps as possible in 4 minutes of:  
100 pound Thruster, 15 reps  
15 Chest to bar Pull-ups  
  
If 90 reps (3 rounds) are completed in under 4 minutes, time extends to 8 minutes.   
If 180 reps (6 rounds) are completed in under 8 minutes, time extends to 12 minutes.  
If 270 reps (9 rounds) are completed in under 12 minutes, time extends to 16 minutes.  
Etc.  
  
For a downloadable PDF of the workout, click [here](http://media.crossfit.com/games/pdf/CFGOpen2013_EventPDF_13-5_fr3W2qA_1150.pdf).
otherRaw: [Watch the Workout 13.5 Live Announcement on the CrossFit Games site](http://games.crossfit.com/video/open-workout-135-archived-live-footage).
